analysis.cross_check_rule: D18, m18 (both modes) and D18m (F) are checked against 065 per clip in two layers. Audio: content_sha256 must be bit-identical, zero mismatches tolerated - the pre-gain bisection and the render are deterministic given the source, so this is what catches a wrong arm or a wrong limiter. Scores: max |diff| <= 5e-3 AES / 1e-3 CLAP, because 065's score_all calls AES once per condition over the clips still to do, so the batch grouping and hence padding depend on how many clips remain. A fresh full run reproduces 065's grouping exactly; a run resumed after preemption drifts about 1e-3 AES. Measured on a 6-clip smoke run against 065 on 2026-09-22: every content hash identical, 46 conditions differing by up to 9.3e-4 on PQ, CLAP identical (CLAP is already scored per file). 5e-3 is two orders of magnitude below any effect this experiment reads.

decision_rule.axes_disagree: report per axis in the known 064/065 pattern (PC is the one axis that prefers limiting); no pooled claim
decision_rule.cost_already_material_at_D3: even mild limiting costs PQ; report the smallest gain reduction at which the cost is measurable
decision_rule.cost_starts_at_zero_and_deepens_monotoni: the processing cost is gain-reduction driven and grows continuously from zero; 065's -0.77 is the saturated end of that curve
decision_rule.non_monotone: unregistered; exploratory only, and report the gain-reduction versus cost scatter

analysis.exclusion_rule: A clip is dropped from all arms together only if its waveform is degenerate (zero peak or zero RMS); zero such clips are expected.
analysis.multiple_comparisons: Pointwise intervals. No global significance, equivalence or automatic promotion claim.

not_applicable_outputs.floors: scorer floor is below -96 dB and the format floor starts at -42 dB; this ladder stops at -18, so the floors block is meaningless here and is registered as not to be read.
not_applicable_outputs.shape_float: the ladder is truncated at -18 dB, so its argmax sits on the edge rung by construction. Peak locations were settled by 063 and 065 (PQ/CU -21 dB, CE/PC -6 dB, CLAP 0 dB) and are not re-asked.

analysis.prespecified_confound: limiter_minus_scalar at matched L* is a difference between two already-degraded arms. In 065's deep range the scalar arm approaches the scorer floor itself, which shrinks the difference, so the shape of D-m in g is NOT the shape of the processing cost. Processing cost is read only from the primary endpoint.
analysis.prespecified_limits: One checkpoint, one generation seed, one limiter. 064b showed the size of the processing cost varies 12x across limiter implementations, so absolute costs here hold for x42-dpl only; direction and shape are what generalise. AES has no loudness normalisation and is band-limited at 16 kHz, so absolute values are not comparable across papers. A CI covering zero is insufficient evidence, not equivalence. AES and CLAP are not human judgments. If this run is preempted and resumed, AES carries about 1e-3 of batch-composition drift, so summary.json will not be bit-identical to a single-shot run; the contrasts are unaffected.
analysis.primary_endpoint: processing cost at the original level: D<g>m - z0 on PQ (F mode), g in [3,6,9,12,15,18], paired over 5521 clips. Both sides sit at the source loudness, so the only difference is whether the limiter ran. It must approach zero as g approaches zero; 065 measured it saturating near -0.77 PQ for g >= 36.
analysis.scorer_batch_composition_sensitivity: AES scores depend on the composition of the batch of 16 clips they are scored in, at the 1e-3 level. Same family as the CLAP batch-size sensitivity that made CLAP per-file, two orders of magnitude smaller. Cross-run comparison of absolute AES values requires the same batch grouping; all contrasts in this experiment are within-clip and unaffected.
analysis.secondary: limiter_minus_scalar_F and _Q for all four AES axes and CLAP at every rung; per-arm L*/LUFS/peak/crest/zero_fraction covariates; gr_max_db and effective_ceiling_dbfs per limited arm.

completion_evidence.note: Eval-only job: the guest writes its own terminal evidence (evidence.eval_only true) and never claims a training artifact. Per QUEUE.md the terminal's evidence.reports paths must equal this contract's reports paths with matching sha256. Success is terminal.json status=completed plus that sha256.

git_revision_note: The commit that introduced the bound scripts. The contract itself is committed one step later, which cannot be self-referential; the exact file contents are pinned by the bindings sha256, not by this field.

ladder.audio_lifetime: Arm audio is transient: rendered in scoring batches, hash-recorded, scored, then deleted. Each item JSON carries the per-condition content sha256 so a rebuild can be checked against this run.
ladder.description: D<g> is x42-dpl driven with a bisected pre-gain G so that L* falls by exactly g dB, i.e. limiting at an effective ceiling of -1-G dBFS. m<g> is the same clip scalar-attenuated by g dB, so D<g> - m<g> is limiter vs scalar at equal loudness. D<g>m is the limited waveform scaled back to the source L*, so D<g>m - z0 is the processing cost at the original level.

modes.Q: PCM_16 as eval.py writes it; level plus format floor. Registered here for continuity with the published 065 table; the format floor itself starts at -42 dB and is out of range.

launch_authorization.scope: Operator asked on 2026-09-22 to fill the -18..0 dB limiter gap on all four AES axes and queue it as 072 in p2.

protocol.clap_caveat: CLAP F is the float path and CLAP Q the canonical filelist path, as in 065. Absolute CLAP is not comparable to the canonical 48 kHz tables; only its response to the intervention is read.
protocol.generation: none; reuses the 051 hash-verified baseline FLAC

question: Between -18 dB and the original level - the range every real output lives in, and the one gap between 064 (upward) and 065 (downward from -18) - how does the cost of downward limiting behave on all four AES axes and CLAP, and how does the processing cost grow from zero as gain reduction increases?
queue_placement: Normal band per QUEUE.md; 066-071 are the slot0nmv2 pair seats, so 072 is the next free name. Nothing binds to the filename.

resume.behavior: No resume checkpoint is ever written. Planning and scoring are both atomic per-clip JSON, so a restart re-plans and re-scores only the missing clips. autoresume is deliberately empty: pointing it at a file the guest writes on pause would make the cold-start acceptance gate reject every later seat. Pause progress goes to pause_progress, which no acceptance gate reads.

reuses.note: 065's plan/render/score/analyze imported unchanged; this contract changes only ladder_db and limit_db and the output root, so the new rungs are directly comparable to the published 065 table rather than a parallel measurement.

scope_note: This run measures the gap between 064 and 065, not a new direction: the limiter, the source audio and the scorer are all unchanged. What is new is the shallow range on all four AES axes, and the shape of the processing cost between zero gain reduction and the saturation 065 already reported.
